reviewer: Separate prospective method reviewer; same-source, nonblind AI review
decision_explanation: Useful bounded source-footprint preparation, subject to the two narrow implementation/reconciliation conditions below and all existing tests. No visual judgment of these fragments or scientific acceptance is supplied.

review_scope.task: Prospective critique only of first two F3 native core/fringe pixel-set records. No new images, pixel values, annotations or historical curve ordinates read.
review_scope.artifact_class: Working research method critique, not canonical evidence, accepted mapping, engine state or legal finding.
review_scope.authority: Current main/user AGENTS, WORKFLOW, START-HERE and investigation charter remain controlling; their text was read in this continuing investigation. Current curve protocol, numerical contract, human gate, October 7 human confirmation and sample-selection contract were read for this review.

scope_and_human_gate.legitimate_current_progress: Human confirmation covers axes/legends and six anchor locations. It does not accept fragment identity, stroke width, source-native uncertainty, readable support or selected curve coordinates. Provisional footprint preparation remains allowed.
scope_and_human_gate.finite_unit: Six solid-proposal columns plus eight dash-proposal columns, separately labeled; 14 fragment-column entries per reader and 660 raw RGB context cells. There are only eight distinct native x columns across both fragments.
scope_and_human_gate.larger_scope: All fourteen force/energy bolt-count pairs and the eventual 42 paired quantile slots / 84 model entries remain intact. These two local fragments do not become a convenience sample for that later check.
scope_and_human_gate.excluded: No physical ordinate, centerline/radius, continuous branch, dash-gap support rule, admitted displacement interval, spring-shell discrepancy, historical force/energy metric, source-model acceptance, engine state or cause inference.

progress_vs_repeated_locators.genuine_increment: Explicit native pixel membership distinguishes stroke interiors from tentative edges, retains holes/multiple row runs, records empty or truncated columns, and makes disagreement inspectable against every unfiltered context cell. That is information beyond rectangular locator boxes.
progress_vs_repeated_locators.failure_condition: If readers merely reproduce the prior bounding boxes or infer an entire trace from expected line style, the step has not recovered a defensible stroke footprint. If attribution remains unclear, preserve an unresolved/failure record rather than manufacture agreement.
progress_vs_repeated_locators.strongest_challenge: Local dark ink can be identifiable as a raster mark without being securely attributable to the intended F3 spring/shell curve. Core/fringe membership uncertainty and curve identity uncertainty are different. A unanimous pixel set cannot repair unresolved branch/style identity or establish the original pre-raster line.
progress_vs_repeated_locators.progress_limit: A recorded disagreement or unusable local fragment can still be useful bounded progress; it cannot stand for an empty support domain or inability to recover the remaining inventory.

conditions.issue: The two targets share columns 300..305. A globally keyed 'column' schema or repeated-column rejection would conflate/reject valid entries.
conditions.required_disposition: Key entries by fragment ID plus native column; test duplicate rejection within a fragment while accepting the same column in the other fragment. Validate each fragment's exact column list and separate allowed row range.
conditions.arithmetic: Solid proposal has 6 columns; dash proposal has 8; total 14 entries per reader, not 14 distinct x coordinates.

conditions.issue: Two readers can have the same core-plus-fringe outer set but disagree materially about which pixels are core.
conditions.required_disposition: Add a synthetic reconciliation case with equal outer sets and different core/fringe membership. It must retain the classification disagreement rather than report complete agreement. The existing requirement to keep core/fringe differences separate must be reflected in the result.

identity_and_uncertainty_cautions: Treat 'solid' and 'single dash' as provisional fragment proposals, not identity conclusions supplied by filenames, expected physical ordering or human legend confirmation.
Raw RGB values are contextual evidence, not an implicit replacement scalar/color classifier. No new cutoff, automatic closing, connected-branch choice or hole filling is permitted.
A reader's core is a judgment, not a certain interior of an original vector stroke. Fringe is an attributed ambiguity set, not a calibrated confidence region or guaranteed enclosure.
Cells omitted from both lists have not thereby become independently proven background or evidence of absent curve. Preserve explicit ambiguity/gap/truncation statements and the complete raw context.
Candidate ink meeting a target boundary must remain a truncation/identity warning. Do not silently widen the box or treat the artificial column endpoint as a physical curve termination.

Freeze each reader's attributable output before cross-reading. Independence is procedural separation of annotations on the same source, not independent historical evidence or independent error distributions.
Use 'independently checked source hashes' rather than the ambiguous phrase 'independent-source hashes'; there is only one held source raster here.
Record the RGB decoding/conversion method and runtime with the context hash. A decoded JPEG raster and a large resized display do not restore original drawing precision.

prospective_test_assessment.adequate_plan: The declared source/protocol pins, exact target membership, preserved context, malformed-row checks, set-operation controls, overwrite refusal, two identical reconciliations and separate raw-cell/set checks are proportionate to this finite annotation unit.
prospective_test_assessment.concrete_checks: Reject boolean as well as fractional row/column values, duplicate rows, out-of-target rows and same-fragment duplicate columns. Require exactly one RGB record for every context coordinate (298..309,0..54), with no normalization/filtering or dropped cells. Preserve empty and disjoint sets as outcomes rather than errors that force agreement.
required_new_cases: F3-METHOD-01: shared native columns across distinct fragments remain valid.
F3-METHOD-02: equal outer sets with unequal core/fringe partitions remain disagreements.
prospective_test_assessment.independence_ceiling: A separate checker validates recording and set arithmetic. It does not validate the correctness of a reader's stroke attribution, the prior locator choice, curve continuity or physical uncertainty.
prospective_test_assessment.execution_status: No implementation, synthetic tests, decoder operation or reconciliation has been run or verified by this reviewer. This is prospective adequacy, not a claim that tests passed.

acceptance_and_stop.acceptable_deliverable: Two separately frozen, attributable per-fragment annotations; all 660 unfiltered context cells and exact source/derivative/protocol pins; every set and status disagreement retained; declared repeat and separate checks completed, or a preserved failure.
acceptance_and_stop.nonacceptance: Do not average, vote away or widen disagreement into a nominal accepted curve. Intersection is not automatically truth and union is not a validated uncertainty envelope.
acceptance_and_stop.stop: Finish these two fragments and their bounded verification. A wider inventory selection, revised target, support rule or historical metric requires its own declared dependency-complete next step.
